ios.title: Pixel Quest: Match 3 RPG
ios.subtitle: Casual Puzzle Adventure
ios.description:
Embark on an unforgettable journey through magical realms in Pixel Quest, the premier casual match-3 puzzle RPG!

Match radiant gems to unleash devastating magical spells, defeat menacing dungeon bosses, and gather legendary loot to customize your heroes.

Game Features:
- Over 500 handcrafted match 3 puzzle levels with dynamic hazards
- Deep hero progression, gear crafting, and magical skill trees
- Compete in seasonal leaderboards, guild raids, and weekly events
- Completely playable offline with zero internet connection required

Download Pixel Quest today and begin your adventure!
ios.promotionalText: Special Anniversary Event: Log in now to claim 50 free hero summons and exclusive legendary armor!
